title: CodeTutor-supported introductory programming coursework
summary: Entry-level students use CodeTutor during a semester of programming coursework, including assignments and exam preparation. The GPT-3.5 assistant answers questions about syntax, debugging, and task completion, while a control group completes the same course without the tool.

sources.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of LLMs in Introductory Computer Science Education: A Semester-Long Field Study
sources.evidence_quote: We conducted a semester-long, between-subjects study with 50 students using CodeTutor.
